outline.hint: Drag scenes and chapters to change their order, or select a row and press {up} and {down}.

partsOnDone.novel: Parts are on: every chapter belongs to a part.
partsOnDone.game: Acts are on: every chapter belongs to an act.

partsOffDone.novel: Parts removed: the chapters keep their order, the parts are in the trash.
partsOffDone.game: Acts removed: the chapters keep their order, the acts are in the trash.

looseHint.novel: These chapters belong to no part: move them with the Move menu.
looseHint.game: These chapters belong to no act: move them with the Move menu.

empty.novel: A manuscript is made of chapters and scenes: create the first chapter and start writing.
empty.game: A script is made of acts, chapters and scenes: create the first scene, the game starts there.

emptyExplain.novel: A scene tells one moment: a place, a time, someone who wants something. Chapters gather the scenes, and you can change their order whenever you like.
emptyExplain.game: Each scene is a moment of the game: a cutscene, a dialogue, a stretch of exploration. The first one becomes the start scene; choices decide where each one leads.

outline.hintTouch: Press and hold the handle on the left of a row to move it, or open its menu and choose Move.

empty.novel: No chapters in this part: add one, or drag one here.
empty.game: No chapters in this act: add one, or drag one here.

trash.novel: Move to the trash, with its chapters and scenes
trash.game: Move to the trash, with its chapters and scenes

chapter.noPurposeHint: The purpose of the chapter is still to be written.
chapter.trash: Move to the trash, with its scenes

scene.startHint: The scene the game starts from
scene.unreachableHint: No choice leads here from the start scene.
scene.synopsisPlaceholder: Synopsis: what happens, in a sentence or two.

actions.createHint: Enter to create, Esc to close
actions.statusMany: Status of the selected scene | Status of the {n} selected scenes
actions.trashMany: Move the selected scene to the trash | Move the {n} selected scenes to the trash

live.movedMany: {n} scene moved to “{container}”. | {n} scenes moved to “{container}”.
live.statusMany: {n} scene is now “{status}”. | {n} scenes are now “{status}”.

filters.label: Filter
filters.dragOff: While filters are on, dragging is paused: use the Move menu.

page.notFound: This chapter is gone: it may be in the trash.
page.purposePlaceholder: Why does this chapter exist? What changes between its first scene and its last?
page.purposeHint: The purpose is the chapter's reason in the story: what someone finds out, decides or loses. If you cannot write it, the chapter may belong with another one.
page.scenesEmpty: The chapter is still empty: “Start writing” opens its sheet. If you prefer, split it into scenes first, even with just a synopsis.
page.presenceEmpty: No characters or places yet: mention them with {at} in the scenes, or add them from a scene's details.

reading.error: I cannot load the text of this scene.
reading.empty: This chapter has no scenes to read yet.

first.location: The story first comes here in chapter {n}, “{title}”.
first.group: A member first appears in chapter {n}, “{title}”.

empty.character: Not in any scene yet: mention them with {at} as you write.
empty.location: No scene is set here yet: mention it with {at} as you write, or add it from a scene's details.
empty.object: Not in any scene yet: mention it with {at} as you write.
empty.group: No member appears in a scene yet.

strand.novel: No scene belongs to this strand yet: add it from a scene's details.
strand.game: No scene belongs to this storyline or quest yet: add it from a scene's details.
